title: Proper Fitting Selection: Sanitary Tees vs. Wye Fittings
description: Selecting the correct drainage fitting is essential for maintaining proper waste flow and preventing chronic blockages. A sanitary tee features a short-radius sweep designed specifically to transition waste flow from a horizontal branch into a vertical drainage stack. Installing a sanitary tee on its side or back (horizontal-to-horizontal transitions) breaks flow momentum, causes solid waste accumulation, and violates standard plumbing codes. For horizontal directional changes and vertical-to-horizontal sweeps, plumbers must use a combination wye and 1/8 bend or a standard wye paired with a 45-degree elbow to maintain smooth gravity flow.
